headline.title: A quiet Thanksgiving, by the archivist’s count
headline.quip: No verified collapses today, which the archivist is treating as the nation’s one successful holiday rollout. The routers, presumably, are also sitting down to dinner.
headline.summary: The archivist found no verified, widely reported service disruption that began on this date. Searches turned up only unrelated or unconfirmed items.

reasons: Web searches for November 26 returned no corroborated disruption; one vendor marketing page claimed a global routing outage but could not be verified, so it was left out.
Search coverage was thin, so a real event may have been missed.
